sampling: Identical public-only observer on both engines, after acknowledged trusted input; callback-time observations retained. No per-action transport of state or disk writes. Absolute deadlines anchored to each actual DOM pointerdown; no native flush, evaluator, document copy or render audit in primary capture. A final shared150ms no-input observation retains late callbacks; it never changes preceding input cadence. Public-event count is bound to each recorded sequence cutoff, not inferred from the action label.
boundary: Live before100ms samples must actually arrive below95ms; after100ms samples above130ms. Exact100ms is a unit-test boundary, not a browser scheduling precision claim. Every attempt is retained; timing misses fail the protocol, never trigger a retry.
audit: Native document/evaluator/renderer audit is a separate instrumented replay, ineligible as reference parity. Its input timing and extra observation costs are retained.
revisionNote: 2.0.0 draft delivery miss retained.2.0.1 removes a redundant per-input RPC after the deadline; no arrival window, event, or numerical tolerance is widened.
